title: Part 5 词性与动词
goal: 词性判断、动词形式、主谓一致

steps.title: Part 5 是什么样的题
lines: The new printer is more ___ than the old one. (A) rely (B) reliable (C) reliably (D) reliance
新打印机比旧的更___。
Answer: (B) reliable — after "more" and before "than", we need an adjective.
答案 B：more … than 中间要形容词。
Our company offers a ___ benefits package. (A) comprehend (B) comprehensive (C) comprehensively (D) comprehension
我们公司提供___的福利套餐。
Answer: (B) comprehensive — between "a" and the noun "benefits package", we need an adjective.
答案 B：冠词和名词之间要形容词。
steps.note: Part 5 有 30 题：一句话一个空，四个选项。其中三分之一是“词性题”——四个选项是同一个词根的不同形式，不用懂句意，看位置就能选。

steps.title: 看词尾认词性
what: 名词：-tion / -sion / -ment / -ness / -ity / -ance / -ence / -er / -or（decision, payment, reliability, assistance）
形容词：-ive / -able / -ible / -al / -ous / -ful / -ic / -ent / -ant（effective, reliable, financial, various）
副词：形容词 + -ly（effectively, reliably）
动词：-ize / -ify / -en / -ate（organize, verify, widen, calculate）
why: Part 5 词性题的四个选项通常正好是名、动、形、副各一个。认出词尾，就知道每个选项是什么词性。
zh: 中文词性不靠形态（“可靠”既能当形容词也能当名词），英语靠词尾，要把词尾当“标签”记。
ex: decide → decision → decisive → decisively
决定（动）→ 决定（名）→ 果断的 → 果断地
rely → reliance → reliable → reliably
依靠 → 依赖 → 可靠的 → 可靠地
err: We need a decisive.
We need a decision.
冠词后缺名词，decisive 是形容词
The machine works reliable.
The machine works reliably.
修饰动词要副词
steps.sum: -tion/-ment/-ity 名 · -ive/-able/-al/-ous 形 · -ly 副 · -ize/-ify 动。

drill.q: Which word is a noun?
drill.e: assistance（帮助）是名词；assistant 也可作名词（助手），但这里看 -ance 词尾。

drill.q: Which word is an adjective?

steps.title: 位置决定词性：名词位和形容词位
what: 名词位：冠词 / 所有格 / 形容词后面（a ___, our ___, a new ___）；介词后面（for ___）；动词的宾语
形容词位：冠词和名词之间（a ___ plan）；be / become / remain / seem 后面（is ___）；more / most / very / so 后面
看空格左右两边各一个词，就能判断要什么词性。
why: 这是 Part 5 最快的题型：10 秒以内。不需要翻译整句，只看空格前后。
zh: 中文“一个全面的计划”中“全面的”在名词前，英语也是：a comprehensive plan。形容词放名词前这一点和中文一样，难的是要选对词尾。
ex: The hotel offers affordable rooms.
这家酒店提供实惠的房间。
The results were very favorable.
结果非常好。
We are pleased to announce the expansion of our office.
我们很高兴宣布办公室扩建。
err: The plan is not feasibility.
The plan is not feasible.
be 后面用形容词
We need more information about the affordable.
We need more information about the price.
介词后要名词
steps.sum: 冠词 / 介词后 → 名词；冠词与名词之间、be 后 → 形容词。

drill.q: The company has an ___ contract with the supplier.
Please contact us for more ___.
The new design is more ___ than the old one.

a: The plan is not very feasible.
This plan is not very feasible.
The plan isn't very feasible.

steps.text: Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package.
steps.zh: 我们公司提供全面的福利套餐。

steps.q: The conference was held at a ___ hotel in the city center.
There is ___ parking space behind the building.
Her advice was ___ to the success of the project.
This tool is very ___ and can be used for many tasks.
Selling online has become a ___ business.
The results of the survey were very ___. (favor)
a: favorable
favourable

steps.a: Our company offers a comprehensive benefits package.
steps.zh: 我们公司提供全面的福利套餐。

steps.a: The new printer is more reliable than the old one.

steps.zh: 这家酒店提供实惠的房间。
a: The hotel offers affordable rooms.
This hotel offers affordable rooms.

points: 重点：词尾认词性 —— -tion/-ment/-ity 名，-ive/-able/-al/-ous 形，-ly 副，-ize/-ify 动。
重点：看空格前后：冠词 / 介词后要名词；冠词与名词之间、be 后要形容词。

steps.title: 副词题怎么判断
lines: The staff worked ___ to finish the project. (A) diligent (B) diligently (C) diligence (D) more diligent
员工们___工作以完成项目。
Answer: (B) — "worked" is a complete verb, so we need an adverb to describe how.
答案 B：worked 已经是完整的动词，修饰它要用副词。
The report was ___ prepared. (A) meticulous (B) meticulously (C) meticulousness (D) meticulosity
报告准备得___。
Answer: (B) — between "was" and the past participle "prepared", we need an adverb.
答案 B：be 和过去分词之间放副词。
steps.note: 句子“已经完整”时，空格里只能放可以删掉的东西 —— 副词。这一个判断能解决大部分副词题。

steps.title: 副词的四个位置
what: ① be 和过去分词 / -ing 之间：was carefully prepared / is rapidly growing
② 助动词和动词之间：has recently opened / will soon arrive
③ 动词 + 宾语之后（句尾）：finished the work quickly
④ 形容词、副词前面：extremely busy / very carefully
why: 判断方法：把空格去掉，句子仍然完整、语法正确 → 空格是副词。
zh: 中文副词“认真地”“很快地”位置比较固定（动词前）；英语副词位置多，但 Part 5 常考的就是 be + ___ + done 这一种。
ex: The office is periodically inspected.
办公室会定期接受检查。
Sales have consistently increased.
销售额持续增长。
The products are sold exclusively online.
产品只在网上销售。
err: The report was careful checked.
The report was carefully checked.
be 和过去分词之间用副词
She completed the task quick.
She completed the task quickly.
修饰动词用副词
steps.sum: 去掉空格句子仍完整 → 副词（-ly）。

drill.q: The machines are ___ checked for safety.
Our sales have ___ grown over the past five years.
The new policy will be ___ explained at the meeting.

steps.title: 形容词还是副词：看它修饰谁
what: 修饰名词、在 be 后 → 形容词：a punctual employee / He is punctual.
修饰动词、形容词、整句 → 副词：He always arrives punctually.
注意例外：friendly, costly, timely 是形容词（-ly 结尾）；hard, late, fast 形副同形，hardly / lately 意思不同。
why: Part 5 的陷阱常是 -ly 结尾的形容词：a timely response（及时的回复），选 timely 而不是 timelily。
zh: 中文“准时的员工”“准时地到达”靠“的 / 地”区分；英语靠 -ly，但 friendly、timely 这类例外要单独记。
ex: She is a diligent worker.
她是个勤奋的员工。
She works diligently.
她工作勤奋。
Thank you for your timely reply.
感谢您及时的回复。
err: He gave a meticulously presentation.
He gave a meticulous presentation.
修饰名词用形容词
The staff are very friendlily.
The staff are very friendly.
friendly 本身是形容词
steps.sum: 修饰名词 / be 后 → 形容词；修饰动词形容词 → 副词；friendly / timely 是形容词。

drill.q: Mr. Ito is known for being ___.
We appreciate your ___ response.

steps.q: The schedule is ___ and may change.
The design was approved, and ___ the team began production.
The budget has changed, so please adjust your plans ___.
The manager was ___ to approve the extra cost.
These are only ___ results; the final report will come next month.
She checked every number ___. (meticulous)
a: meticulously

steps.zh: 这些产品只在网上销售。
a: These products are sold exclusively online.
The products are sold exclusively online.

points: 重点：副词位 —— be 和过去分词之间、助动词和动词之间、句尾、形容词前；去掉仍完整就是副词。
重点：friendly、timely 是形容词；hard / hardly、late / lately 意思不同。

steps.title: 动词题看什么
lines: By the end of next month, we ___ the new system. (A) implement (B) implemented (C) will have implemented (D) have implemented
到下个月底，我们将___新系统。
Answer: (C) — "by" + a future time needs the future perfect.
答案 C：by + 将来时间 → 将来完成时。
The new policy ___ last week. (A) implemented (B) was implemented (C) implements (D) is implementing
新政策上周___。
Answer: (B) — there is no object, and a policy cannot implement itself, so we need the passive.
答案 B：后面没有宾语，政策不能自己实施，用被动。
steps.note: 动词题两步：① 时间词决定时态 ② 后面有没有宾语决定主动还是被动。

steps.title: 时间词 → 时态（Part 5 版）
what: since / for + 时间段 / so far / recently → 现在完成时（has done）
by + 将来时间 / by the time + 现在时 → 将来完成时（will have done）
yesterday / last / ago / in 2020 → 过去时；next / soon / tomorrow → 将来
when / if / as soon as / before / after 从句里说将来 → 用现在时
why: 第一学期学过五个时态，这里加上 Part 5 爱考的将来完成时（will have done）：“到某时为止将已经完成”。
zh: 中文“到月底我们就完成了”很自然；英语要用 will have finished，因为是“将来某时之前完成”。
ex: Sales have exceeded expectations since the launch.
上市以来销量超出预期。
By Friday, the team will have completed the report.
到周五，团队将已完成报告。
We will start as soon as the manager arrives.
经理一到我们就开始。
err: We will start when the manager will arrive.
We will start when the manager arrives.
时间从句用现在时表将来
By next year, we finish the project.
By next year, we will have finished the project.
by + 将来 → 将来完成
steps.sum: since → has done；by + 将来 → will have done；时间从句用现在时。

drill.q: Revenue ___ steadily since the new manager arrived.
By the time you arrive, the meeting ___.
Please call me as soon as the shipment ___.

steps.title: 主动还是被动：看后面有没有宾语
what: 及物动词后面有宾语 → 主动：The manager implemented the plan.
后面没有宾语（直接是介词、句号）→ 多半是被动：The plan was implemented last week.
再用常识检查：主语能不能自己做这个动作？（政策不能“实施”别的东西）
why: 这是 Part 5 每套都有的题。四个选项常是 implemented / was implemented / is implementing / has implemented。先看宾语，再看时间词，两步就能定。
zh: 中文常省略被动标记（“政策上周实施了”），英语必须写 was implemented。
ex: All visitors must be verified at the entrance.
所有访客都必须在入口处核验身份。
The building is undergoing renovation.
大楼正在翻修。
Ms. Park oversees the marketing team.
朴女士负责管理市场团队。
err: The new system implemented last month.
The new system was implemented last month.
系统是被实施的
The manager was approved the budget.
The manager approved the budget.
有宾语 budget → 主动
steps.sum: 动词后有宾语 → 主动；没宾语 → 被动（be + done），再用常识检查。

drill.q: The construction ___ by a local company.
Ms. Kim ___ the merger of the two departments last year.

drill.zh: 所有订单都会被加急处理。
a: All orders will be expedited.
All the orders will be expedited.

steps.text: The new policy was implemented last week.
steps.focus: implemented 重音在第一音节 IM

steps.q: The ceremony will ___ at 10 a.m. sharp.
The company decided to ___ the old model next year.
Our sales this year have ___ last year's record.
The two offices will be ___ into one.
The new software will help ___ the ordering process.
The cost must not ___ the budget. (exceed)
a: exceed

steps.a: By Friday, the team will have completed the report.

steps.zh: 请在提交前核实所有数据。
a: Please verify all the data before submitting it.
Please verify all data before you submit it.

points: 重点：since → has done；by + 将来 → will have done；时间从句用现在时表将来。
重点：有宾语 → 主动；没宾语 → 被动；再用常识检查。

steps.title: 看清真正的主语
lines: The list of new applicants ___ on the manager's desk. (A) is (B) are (C) were (D) have been
新申请人名单___在经理桌上。
Answer: (A) — the subject is "the list", not "applicants".
答案 A：主语是 the list，不是 applicants。
Each of the rooms ___ a view of the ocean. (A) have (B) has (C) are having (D) were
每个房间都___海景。
Answer: (B) — "each of" takes a singular verb.
答案 B：each of 后面动词用单数。
steps.note: 长主语里夹着介词短语时，动词要和“核心名词”一致，不要被离动词最近的名词骗了。

steps.title: 长主语：找核心名词
what: The list of applicants is … —— 核心是 list（单数）
The amenities in the hotel are … —— 核心是 amenities（复数）
方法：把 of / in / for / with 引导的介词短语括起来，剩下的才是主语。
why: TOEIC 的句子主语经常很长：The number of patrons who visited the museum last month ___。括号法：The number ___ → is。
the number of + 复数 → 单数动词；a number of + 复数 → 复数动词（= many）。
zh: 中文没有主谓一致，中国学生最容易被“最近的名词”带偏。
ex: The quality of the products is excellent.
产品质量非常好。
A number of patrons have complained.
有不少顾客投诉。
The number of recipients has doubled.
收件人数量翻了一倍。
err: The list of names are on the desk.
The list of names is on the desk.
核心是 list
The number of visitors have increased.
The number of visitors has increased.
the number of → 单数
steps.sum: 把介词短语括起来找核心名词；the number of 单数，a number of 复数。

drill.q: The price of these items ___ gone up.
A number of employees ___ asked for flexible hours.
The amenities at the new hotel ___ impressive.

steps.title: each / every / one of + 单数动词
what: Each employee has / Every room is / Each of the rooms has
One of the reasons is …（“其中之一”是单数）
Both A and B → 复数；Either A or B / Neither A nor B → 动词跟靠近的 B
why: one of + 复数名词 + 单数动词，是 Part 5 和写作里最常考的一致题。
zh: 中文“每个房间都有”的“都”让人想用复数，英语 each / every 一律单数。
ex: Each applicant must submit two references.
每位申请人都必须提交两份推荐信。
One of our goals is to reduce costs.
我们的目标之一是降低成本。
Neither the manager nor the staff members were informed.
经理和员工都没被通知。
err: Every employees have a parking space.
Every employee has a parking space.
every + 单数名词 + 单数动词
One of the reasons are the price.
One of the reasons is the price.
one of … is
steps.sum: each / every / one of → 单数；both → 复数；either / neither → 跟近的。

drill.q: Each of the candidates ___ interviewed by two managers.
One of the most popular amenities ___ the rooftop pool.

steps.text: One of our goals is to reduce costs.
steps.zh: 我们的目标之一是降低成本。

steps.q: Attendance at the safety training is ___ for all staff.
The parking lot is ___ to the main building.
Sales have risen for three ___ quarters.
The offer is ___ on the results of a background check.
Employees who are ___ in Spanish are preferred.
The company offers a bonus as an ___ for good performance.
a: incentive

steps.a: Each of the rooms has a view of the ocean.
The list of new applicants is on the manager's desk.

steps.zh: 这次需求是前所未有的。
a: The demand was unprecedented.
This level of demand is unprecedented.
The demand this time was unprecedented.

points: 重点：括起介词短语找核心名词；the number of 单数 / a number of 复数。
重点：each / every / one of → 单数；both → 复数；either / neither → 跟近的。

steps.title: 30 题、10 分钟
lines: Part 5 has 30 questions. Try to finish them in about ten minutes.
Part 5 共 30 题，争取十分钟左右做完。
First, look at the four options and decide what type of question it is.
先看四个选项，判断题型。
Word form and verb questions can be answered by looking at the words around the blank.
词性题和动词题，看空格前后就能答。
Only vocabulary questions need you to understand the whole sentence.
只有词汇题需要读懂整句。
steps.note: 这一课把前四课串起来：先分类，再用对应的方法，把时间省给阅读 Part 7。

steps.title: Part 5 解题顺序：先看选项，再看空格
what: ① 选项是同一词根的不同形式 → 词性题：看空格前后（5 秒）
② 选项是同一动词的不同形式 → 动词题：主谓一致 → 时间词 → 主动被动（10 秒）
③ 选项是 although / despite / because / due to → 连接词题：看后面是句子还是名词
④ 选项意思各不相同 → 词汇题：读整句，看搭配（20 秒）
why: 顺序很重要：先花 2 秒看选项分类，就不会在词性题上浪费时间去翻译整句。
zh: 中国考生习惯先读题干再看选项，Part 5 反过来做更快。
ex: The fee will be ___ for early registrants. (waived / waive / waiver / waiving)
提前注册者免收费用。—— 词性题：will be + 过去分词。
err: The fee will be waive for members.
The fee will be waived for members.
will be + 过去分词：看位置就能选
steps.sum: 先看选项分类 → 词性看位置 / 动词看一致时态语态 / 连接词看后面 / 词汇看搭配。

drill.q: The fee will be ___ for members.
The hotel can ___ up to 300 guests.

steps.title: 介词还是连词：后面是名词还是句子
what: 后面是名词 / doing → 介词：despite / in spite of / because of / due to / during
后面是句子（主语 + 谓语）→ 连词：although / even though / because / while
despite the rain ↔ although it rained · because of the delay ↔ because the train was late · during the meeting ↔ while we were meeting
why: 这一组每套必考 1–2 题，只要看空格后面有没有谓语动词就能选。
zh: 中文“虽然下雨”“尽管下雨”后面都能接任何东西；英语 although 接句子，despite 接名词，不能混。
ex: Despite the heavy rain, the event was a success.
尽管下大雨，活动还是很成功。
Although it rained heavily, the event was a success.
虽然雨下得很大，活动还是很成功。
The flight was delayed due to bad weather.
航班因天气恶劣而延误。
err: Although the delay, we finished on time.
Despite the delay, we finished on time.
名词前用 despite
Despite he was tired, he kept working.
Although he was tired, he kept working.
句子前用 although
steps.sum: 后面是名词 → despite / because of / during；是句子 → although / because / while。

drill.q: ___ the budget cuts, the project was completed.
The store closed early ___ the manager was sick.
Please turn off your phone ___ the presentation.

steps.text: Despite the heavy rain, the event was a success.
steps.zh: 尽管下大雨，活动还是很成功。

steps.q: The company will ___ more funds to research next year.
Please ___ all expenses on the reimbursement form.
The contract ___ that payment must be made within 30 days.
The apartment has been ___ since March.
Ms. Ross was ___ for the Employee of the Year award.
___ the high cost, many customers still bought the product.
The new process ___ better results than expected. (yield)
a: yielded

steps.a: Please remit payment within thirty days.

steps.zh: 所有员工都必须遵守安全规定。
a: All employees must comply with the safety rules.
All staff must comply with the safety regulations.

points: 重点：Part 5 先看选项分类，再用对应方法。
重点：名词前 despite / because of / during；句子前 although / because / while。

lessons.title: 单元阅读：Notice: Changes to the Expense Policy

steps.title: Notice: Changes to the Expense Policy
steps.note: TOEIC Part 7 式的阅读：先看题目再读文章，带着问题找答案。先关掉译文读。
lines: To all employees:
全体员工：
As of July 1, a new expense policy will be implemented across the company.
自 7 月 1 日起，全公司将实施新的报销制度。
The goal is to streamline the reimbursement process and reduce paperwork.
目的是简化报销流程，减少文书工作。
Under the new policy, all expenses must be itemized and submitted online within ten days.
按照新制度，所有费用必须逐项列明，并在十天内在线提交。
Receipts are mandatory for any single item that exceeds fifty dollars.
单项超过五十美元必须附收据。
Each request will be verified by the accounting department before payment is made.
每份申请在付款前都会由会计部核实。
Although most employees have used the old paper forms for years, the new system is user-friendly.
虽然大多数员工多年来一直用纸质表格，但新系统使用起来很方便。
A short training session will be held in the main conference room on June 25.
6 月 25 日将在大会议室举办一次简短培训。
Attendance is not required, but it is highly recommended.
不强制参加，但强烈推荐。
Questions about the policy should be directed to Ms. Rivera in Accounting.
关于该制度的问题请咨询会计部的里维拉女士。

steps.q: What is the purpose of the notice?
o: To announce a new expense policy

steps.q: What must employees do for items over fifty dollars?
Who will verify the requests?
What is true about the training session?
o: It is mandatory for all staff.
steps.e: Attendance is not required —— 选项把它换成了 optional。

steps.q: The word "streamline" in line 3 is closest in meaning to

steps.zh: 所有费用必须逐项列明。
